reason: My bookkeeper already runs everything through our expense app and it works well enough. Adding a Telegram bot and a separate Google Sheet means two places to check, and I'm not going to make her change her setup for this.
objection: I doubt it really catches a duplicate when a driver re-photographs a crumpled nota at a different angle, or when two staff send the same transfer screenshot. If it misses those, it's just another receipt-to-table bot and we're still reconciling by hand.
would_change_my_mind: Running it on our old chat archive for free and seeing it flag real duplicates my bookkeeper missed, plus it exporting cleanly into the app we already use instead of only a Google Sheet.
